title: StreamDiT: Real-Time Streaming Text-to-Video Generation
tldr_zh: 流匹配加移动缓冲训练 4B 模型，蒸馏后单 GPU 16 FPS 流式生成 512p 视频
tldr_en: Flow matching with moving buffer trains 4B model; distilled to 16 FPS streaming 512p on one GPU

key_numbers.number: Mixed training all chunk sizes Quality Score 0.8144
10K iterations per stage on 128 H100 GPUs
TAE compression 4x temporal, 8x spatial, latent channel 8
50 prompts for VBench and human evaluation

relations.type: complementary: VDOT provides OT distillation objective; StreamDiT provides streaming buffer distillation structure
contrast: HIWYN optimizes frame-to-frame noise transport; StreamDiT uses shared noise with monotonic tau without OT coupling
competitor: Self-Forcing AR streaming vs StreamDiT buffer full-attention streaming
